{{short description|Mathematician}}
[[File:Michael Röckner.jpg|thumb|Michael Röckner]]
'''Michael Röckner''' is a mathematician working in the fields of [[Stochastic analysis]] and Mathematical Physics.

He obtained his PhD at [[Bielefeld University]] in 1984 under the supervision of [[Sergio Albeverio]] and [[Christopher John Preston]].

Together with Claudia Prévôt, he wrote the book ''A Concise Course on Stochastic Partial Differential Equations''.<ref name="Fakultät für Mathematik">{{cite web | url=http://www.math.uni-bielefeld.de/~roeckner/ | title=Michael Röckner | publisher=Universität Bielefeld | date=July 10, 2007 | accessdate=May 7, 2011 | author=Wiesinger, Sven}}</ref>
